summary: Iter 215ax — GymAxis Premium UI Phase 3 CRM Pipeline rebrand testing. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Pulse-branded CRM user (craig.henshall@pulsefitness.com) is seeing GymAxis branding instead of Pulse branding. The user's crm_brand field is not being set/returned by the CRM login endpoint. Pulse safety net tests PASSED for landing page and lite-dashboard. CRM tab navigation working correctly.

critical.issue: CRM login endpoint does NOT return crm_brand field in user object. The field is computed in _resolve_crm_brand_flags() but not included in the login response. This causes Pulse-branded users to see GymAxis branding.
critical.expected: crm_brand: 'pulse' should be returned for users in Pulse Fitness org
critical.actual: crm_brand field is missing from login response

minor.issue: The /me endpoint also doesn't return crm_brand because the field doesn't exist in the crm_users document for legacy users created before the crm_brand logic was added

integration_issues.issue: CRM internal theme state (isDark) doesn't sync with navbar theme toggle. The CRM reads theme from localStorage on mount but doesn't listen for changes from other components. This is a minor UX issue - the CRM has its own theme toggle that works correctly.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /api/crm/auth/login to include crm_brand field in the user response object
CRITICAL: Update existing crm_users documents to include crm_brand field (can be done via the _provision_or_refresh_crm_user function which already has this logic)
Ensure the login endpoint calls _resolve_crm_brand_flags() and includes the result in the response
Consider adding a migration script to backfill crm_brand for existing CRM users
critical_code_review_comments: Line 184-194 in /app/backend/routes/crm_auth.py: The login response does NOT include crm_brand field. The field is computed in _resolve_crm_brand_flags() (line 248-269) but only used in the cross-login flow, not the direct CRM login.
The isPulseBrandedCRM check in CRMApp.js (line 451) relies on user.crm_brand === 'pulse' but this field is never returned by the login endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 215ax Phase 3 CRM rebrand has a CRITICAL bug: Pulse-branded users see GymAxis branding because crm_brand field is not returned by the CRM login endpoint. The fix requires updating /api/crm/auth/login to include crm_brand in the response. Pulse safety net (landing page + lite-dashboard) is working correctly - no theme-gymaxis leakage.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Pulse-branded CRM users see GymAxis branding
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The /api/crm/auth/login endpoint (lines 150-194 in crm_auth.py) does not include crm_brand field in the response. The field is computed in _resolve_crm_brand_flags() but only used in the cross-login flow (/api/crm/auth/cross-login), not the direct CRM login.
reproduction_steps: 1. Login to CRM as craig.henshall@pulsefitness.com / Test123!
2. Observe the h1 wordmark shows 'GymAxis' with gradient instead of 'Pulse Fitness'
3. Check the login response - crm_brand field is missing
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Update the /api/crm/auth/login endpoint to compute and return crm_brand field based on the user's organization. The logic already exists in _resolve_crm_brand_flags() - it just needs to be called and included in the response.
